title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Payments Decision Table: Catch-Up Coverage After Later Statements
content:
**Rule.** For a catch-up payment on a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account — the missed statement being the statement of the billing period the most recent late fee on the account belongs to — the catch-up coverage follows the statements issued since: when the latest statement is for a later billing period than the missed statement and its payment due date falls no later than 21 calendar days after the day of the catch-up payment (a due date already passed included), the coverage is the minimum payment due shown on the latest statement; when the latest statement is for a later billing period and its payment due date is later than that, the coverage is the past-due amount shown on the latest statement; when no later statement has been issued, the coverage is the missed minimum.

## Decision table

| Latest statement | Its payment due date against the day of the catch-up payment | Catch-up coverage |
|---|---|---|
| for a later billing period than the missed statement | no later than 21 calendar days after, or already passed | the minimum payment due shown on the latest statement |
| for a later billing period than the missed statement | later than 21 calendar days after | the past-due amount shown on the latest statement |
| the missed statement itself (no later statement issued) | — | the missed minimum |

## Cases (hypothetical; missed statement for April, catch-up payment on 10 June)

| Latest statement | Its payment due date | Coverage |
|---|---|---|
| May period, minimum USD 120.00, past-due USD 55.00 | 25 June (15 days after) | USD 120.00 |
| May period, minimum USD 120.00, past-due USD 55.00 | 1 July (21 days after) | USD 120.00 |
| May period, minimum USD 120.00, past-due USD 55.00 | 5 July (25 days after) | USD 55.00 |
| May period, minimum USD 120.00, past-due USD 55.00 | 2 June (already passed) | USD 120.00 |
| April period, minimum USD 55.00 | 28 April | USD 55.00, the missed minimum |
